name: India Glycols Limited
summary: India Glycols Limited manufactures and sells bio-based specialities and performance chemicals in India and internationally. It operates through Bio-based Specialities and Performance Chemicals, Potable Spirits, Ennature Biopharma, and Bio-Fuel segments. The company offers bio mono ethylene, di ethylene, and tri ethylene glycols; ethylene and diethylene glycol monoethyl ethers, ethylene and diethylene glycol monoethyl ether acetates, and brake fluids; biopolymers from agricultural guar gum, tamarind gum, and cassia gum; biofuels, which include ethanol, DDGS, and DWGS; specialty chemicals, such as plasticizers, oil fields chemicals, bioamines, methyl soyate, methyl diethanolamine (MDEA) and MD…
